probability_design.frame: All current materialized v5 memberships, not only proposed exclusions
probability_design.selection: Smallest seeded SHA256 keys within each language; fixed seed randomized-design convention
probability_design.purpose: Paired exclusion precision, correct-link false-removal risk and erroneous-link detection recall within existing materialized v5; not missing-member discovery recall

splits.challenge: separate nonprobability evaluation; never pooled into estimator

independence: No release training/calibration exists. Historical exposure audit is required; incomplete native/sense/evidence mappings block independent-holdout certification. Do not replace exposed sampled rows or change design weights.
arbitration: Third qualified human, bound exact independent judgments; every uncertain/conflict plus prespecified 10% agreement audit

v6_gates.minimum_independent_gold_per_stratum: calculated exact one-sided binomial zero-error requirement, adjusted for 12 strata
v6_gates.threshold_changes: new protocol ID and untouched held-out sample required

new_semantic_safety.scope: Additional conservative proposed-removal gate; does not redefine inherited false-merge endpoint
new_semantic_safety.comparison_policy: Bonferroni across all predeclared 5 configurations x 10 views x 3 safety endpoints = 150; never fewer than inherited12

cluster_policy: Use linked family/lemma/evidence groups, never expand family operations into independent observations; cross-language dependence retained. Unknown dependence blocks exact-binomial gate.

confidence_intervals.descriptive: weighted linked-cluster bootstrap, 2000 repetitions, fixed seed; unresolved/full-frame sensitivity bounds
confidence_intervals.safety: one-sided exact binomial only with independently verified independent Bernoulli units; simultaneous alpha .05/150
